There are three gray parts in total: one quadrant in the small circle, one quadrant of the middle annular layer, and one quadrant of the outer annular layer. The problem states that these three gray regions have equal areas, and the radius of the small circle is 1. Let the radii of the three circles be 1, r, and R respectively. The area of the gray quadrant of the small circle is π·1²/4 = π/4. The area of the gray quadrant of the middle annular layer is π(r² - 1)/4.
